skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find common denominators
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions with unlike denominators as equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Decompose mixed numbers into whole-number and fractional parts and subtract or combine the whole-number parts appropriately.

skills.name: Regroup for fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow one whole and convert it into fractional units when the minuend's fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend's fractional part or is absent.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed fractions
skills.definition: Interpret and normalize mixed numbers whose fractional part is improper before carrying out subtraction.
